component.name: Kraken Desktop
component.summary: Real-time crypto market dashboards and trading

description.p: This community package is maintained independently of Kraken. It installs the vendor's unmodified desktop application from its official Linux download.

Kraken Desktop is a native trading app for the Kraken exchange. Build real-time crypto market dashboards from any combination of candle charts, order books, time and sales feeds and order entry, spread them across several windows and monitors, and trade from them. A Kraken account is required to sign in.
